goal.en: Ask good questions at the end of the interview and find out the next steps.
goal.zh: 在面試尾聲提出好問題，並問清楚接下來的流程。

background: meeting room with a long wooden table, two chairs facing each other, a closed notepad, warm pendant lamps glowing, glass wall, soft early evening light

intro.en: Ms. Wong checks the time and puts her pen down.
intro.zh: 王經理看了看時間，把筆放下。

intro.en: You've answered every question. Now the interview turns around.
intro.zh: 你已經回答完所有問題。現在，面試要換個方向了。

lines.en: Well, that's all from me. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.zh: 好，我這邊問完了。你有什麼問題想問我們嗎？

choices.en: No, no questions. You explained everything very clearly.
choices.zh: 沒有，沒有問題。你都說明得很清楚了。

lines.en: None at all? Hmm, most candidates have at least one.
lines.zh: 完全沒有？嗯，大部分應徵者至少都會問一個。

story.en: You meant it as a compliment. Ms. Wong hears 'not very interested' and writes it down.
story.zh: 你本來是想稱讚她。王經理聽到的卻是「不太有興趣」，還把它記了下來。

fail.why: 在台灣，不發問可能是客氣；但在英語面試裡，沒有問題會被當成對工作沒興趣。準備一兩個問題，例如 What does a typical day look like in this role?。

choices.en: Yes, a few. What does a typical day look like in this role?
choices.zh: 有幾個。這個職位一天的工作大概是什麼樣子？
choices.tip: What does a typical day look like? 是面試尾聲最經典、最安全的好問題。

choices.en: Yes. Can I work from home most days? I really hate commuting.
choices.zh: 有。我可以大部分時間在家工作嗎？我真的很討厭通勤。

lines.en: This role meets clients in person, Kai. A lot.
lines.zh: 凱，這個職位要當面見客戶，而且很常。

story.en: Your first question tells Ms. Wong what you don't want to do. Not the best way to end a great interview.
story.zh: 你的第一個問題，讓王經理知道你不想做什麼。這不是結束一場好面試的好方式。

fail.why: 一開口就提自己的要求，還說「討厭」，聽起來像在挑工作。先問工作內容：What does a typical day look like in this role?，條件留到錄取後再談。

lines.en: Good question. You'd help our sales team with client calls, product samples and social media. Some days, you'd visit hotels and cafés with us.
lines.zh: 好問題。你會協助業務團隊處理客戶電話、產品樣品和社群媒體。有些日子會跟我們一起去拜訪飯店和咖啡店。

choices.en: Hotels? Cool! Do I get to stay in the hotel rooms for free sometimes?
choices.zh: 飯店？酷！我有時候可以免費住飯店房間嗎？

lines.en: Ha! Sadly, no. We sell them lights. They don't give us rooms.
lines.zh: 哈！可惜沒有。我們是賣燈給他們，他們不會給我們房間。

story.en: Ms. Wong laughs, but now she wonders if you're applying for the job or for a vacation.
story.zh: 王經理笑了，但她開始懷疑你是來應徵工作，還是來度假的。

fail.why: 對方介紹工作內容時，應該順著問工作相關的事，不是問有什麼好康。可以問 Who would I be working with most closely?。

choices.en: That sounds great. Who would I be working with most closely?
choices.zh: 聽起來很棒。我主要會跟哪些人一起工作？
choices.tip: Who would I be working with? 用 would 假設已錄取，語氣禮貌又積極。

choices.en: That sounds great. Who I will work with the most?
choices.zh: 聽起來很棒。我最常會跟誰一起工作？

lines.en: Who you will...? Oh, sorry, was that a question?
lines.zh: Who you will……？喔，抱歉，那是一個問句嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong waits for the rest of your sentence. You wait for her answer. It's a very long, very quiet moment.
story.zh: 王經理在等你把話說完，你在等她回答。那是一段很長、很安靜的沉默。

fail.why: 英文問句要把助動詞放到主詞前面：Who will I work with? 或更禮貌的 Who would I be working with?。

lines.en: Mostly with me and the rest of our small sales team. Anything else?
lines.zh: 主要是跟我，還有我們小小的業務團隊。還有別的問題嗎？

choices.en: How many days off do I get? I'd like to visit Taiwan often.
choices.zh: 我一年有幾天假？我想常常回台灣。

lines.en: Often? Well... we can talk about leave if we make you an offer.
lines.zh: 常常？嗯……如果我們決定錄取你，再來談休假吧。

story.en: Ms. Wong pictures your desk empty for half the year. She makes a small note with a question mark.
story.zh: 王經理想像你的座位有半年都是空的。她記下一筆，後面加了個問號。

fail.why: 第一次面試就問休假，還說想常回國，會讓人覺得你心不在這裡。休假和薪資等拿到錄取後再談，現在先問工作和團隊：What do you enjoy most about working here?。

choices.en: What do you enjoy most about working at Brightway?
choices.zh: 你在 Brightway 工作最喜歡的是什麼？
choices.tip: 問面試官自己的經驗，能了解公司文化，也讓對話更有溫度。

choices.en: Is the team friendly? Do people here have human taste?
choices.zh: 團隊友善嗎？這裡的人有人情味嗎？

lines.en: Human taste? I really hope nobody here has tasted a human!
lines.zh: 人的味道？我真心希望這裡沒有人吃過人！

story.en: Ms. Wong bursts out laughing. Your question about warm coworkers just turned into a horror movie.
story.zh: 王經理笑到不行。你想問同事溫不溫暖，結果變成了恐怖片。

fail.why: 「人情味」直譯成 human taste，聽起來像在問有沒有人吃人。想問團隊氣氛，說 Is the team friendly? 或 What's the team culture like?。

lines.en: Honestly? The people. And seeing our lights in real cafés all over town. What else?
lines.zh: 老實說？是這裡的人。還有在城裡各家咖啡店看到我們的燈。還有嗎？

choices.en: When will you tell me the result? I am very want to know.
choices.zh: 你們什麼時候會通知我結果？我非常想知道。

lines.en: You are very... want? Don't worry, we'll be in touch soon.
lines.zh: 你非常……want？別擔心，我們很快會聯絡你。

story.en: Your eager question comes out a little broken. Ms. Wong gives you a kind but very vague answer.
story.zh: 你急切的問題說得有點破碎。王經理給了你一個親切卻非常模糊的回答。

fail.why: want 是動詞，前面不能加 am very。要說 I really want to know.，但更專業的問法是 What are the next steps?。

choices.en: What are the next steps in the hiring process?
choices.zh: 接下來的招募流程是什麼？
choices.tip: What are the next steps? 讓你知道何時會有消息，也顯示你很認真看待這份工作。

choices.en: So, did I pass? Just tell me now, yes or no.
choices.zh: 所以，我有過嗎？現在就告訴我，有還是沒有。

lines.en: I'm afraid it doesn't work like that, Kai.
lines.zh: 凱，恐怕不是這樣運作的。

story.en: Ms. Wong's smile becomes very professional. An interview is not a lottery ticket you can scratch on the spot.
story.zh: 王經理的笑容變得非常公事公辦。面試不是刮刮樂，不能當場刮開看結果。

fail.why: 當場逼問「我有沒有過」會給人很大壓力，顯得沒耐心。禮貌地問流程：What are the next steps in the hiring process?。

lines.en: Next week, there's a second interview. Rachel will email you the details. Anything else before we finish?
lines.zh: 下週會有第二次面試，瑞秋會寄細節給你。結束前還有其他問題嗎？

choices.en: No, that's everything. Thank you so much for your time today.
choices.zh: 沒有了，就這些。非常謝謝你今天撥空。
choices.tip: Thank you for your time. 是結束面試時最得體的一句話。

choices.en: Not really. Oh, I brought you some pineapple cakes from Taiwan!
choices.zh: 沒什麼了。喔，我帶了一些台灣的鳳梨酥給你！

lines.en: That's very kind... but I can't accept gifts from candidates. It wouldn't be fair.
lines.zh: 你真貼心……不過我不能收應徵者的禮物，這樣不公平。

story.en: The pineapple cakes go back into your bag. You eat all of them on the bus home, one sad bite at a time.
story.zh: 鳳梨酥又回到你的包包裡。回家的公車上，你一口一口、心情複雜地把它們全吃完了。

fail.why: 在台灣帶伴手禮是禮貌，但在面試場合送面試官禮物，可能被看成想影響結果。用一句真誠的道謝結束就好：Thank you so much for your time today.。

choices.en: Not really. By the way, do you know any good hot pot places near here?
choices.zh: 沒什麼了。對了，你知道這附近有好吃的火鍋店嗎？

lines.en: Uh... there's one on Pine Street, I think. Anyway, thanks for coming in.
lines.zh: 呃……松樹街好像有一家吧。總之，謝謝你今天過來。

story.en: You end a serious interview with a restaurant question. At least dinner is sorted.
story.zh: 你用一個問餐廳的問題結束了正式面試。至少晚餐有著落了。

fail.why: 面試結尾問私人生活的事，會讓前面的好表現打折扣。最後一句留給道謝：Thank you so much for your time today.。

lines.en: Thank you, Kai. You asked really good questions. We'll be in touch soon.
lines.zh: 謝謝你，凱。你問的問題都很好。我們很快會再聯絡你。

lines.en: Outside, the sun is setting over Harbor Street. You let out the longest breath of your life.
lines.zh: 走出大樓，夕陽正落在港灣街上。你吐出這輩子最長的一口氣。

story.en: Your questions showed you were already imagining yourself on the team. Ms. Wong noticed.
story.zh: 你的問題顯示你已經在想像自己成為團隊的一員。王經理也注意到了。

notes.en: What does a typical day look like?
notes.zh: 一天的工作大概是什麼樣子？
notes.explain: 面試尾聲最常用的好問題，能了解實際工作內容，也顯示你在想像自己上班的樣子。

example.en: What does a typical week look like for the sales team?
example.zh: 業務團隊一週的工作大概是什麼樣子？

notes.explain: 禮貌地問什麼時候會有結果，比 Did I pass? 或 When will you tell me? 專業得多。

example.en: What are the next steps, and when should I expect to hear from you?
example.zh: 接下來的流程是什麼？我大概什麼時候會收到消息？

notes.en: Who would I be working with?
notes.explain: 英文問句要把助動詞放到主詞前面，不能說 Who I will work with?。用 would 語氣更禮貌。

example.en: Where would I be sitting? Who would I report to?
example.zh: 我會坐在哪裡？我要向誰報告？

notes.explain: 「人情味」不能直譯 human taste，說 friendly 或 warm；want 是動詞，不能說 I'm very want，要說 I really want。

example.en: The people here are really warm. I really want to join them.
example.zh: 這裡的人很有人情味，我很想加入他們。

notes.en: Always ask at least one question
notes.explain: 說「沒有問題」會被當成沒興趣。問工作內容、團隊、流程；休假和薪水等拿到錄取再談。面試也不要送禮，以免被誤會。

example.en: Could you tell me more about the team I'd be joining?
example.zh: 可以多介紹一下我會加入的團隊嗎？
